title: Play a podcast I follow
summary: Plays a podcast the person follows in the Podcasts applet: the show they name (where they left off, or its newest episode), or whatever they last listened to.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks to play, resume or listen to a podcast they follow; not to make one.

arguments.name: show
arguments.description: The show they named; empty to resume the last one

_note: Phase AV.22 (2026-11-12): the Podcasts applet for the agent, through its own service.
